title: Thuppakki Munai
desc: Birla Bose, an encounter specialist, takes on a rape and murder case in Rameswaram. Upon discovering the accused's innocence, he embarks on a quest to uncover the true perpetrators.

title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Vaazhai
desc: Forced into labour to repay family debts, young Sivanaindhan grapples with severe hardships brought on by extreme poverty.

title: Aruvam
desc: A woman with anosmia experiences paranormal events and soon finds herself involved in a series of mysterious murders linked to food adulteration.

title: Surya's Saturday
desc: Surya, a young man with anger issues, channels his emotions on Saturdays, because of a promise to his deceased mother. However, things get complicated when he decides to confront a corrupt cop.

title: Sathuranga Vettai
desc: A cunning fraudster profits from deceiving numerous victims. However, trouble ensues when a criminal group seeks revenge against his betrayal.

title: D Block
desc: When the female students of an engineering college mysteriously disappear and are found dead, a young man and his friends decide to look for the culprit.

title: Ek Niranjan
desc: Kidnapped as a child, Chotu grows up to become a police informer whilst searching for his biological parents. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when he falls in love with Sameera.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Magamuni
desc: Two estranged brothers lead divergent lives until fate reunites them, triggering a cascade of catastrophic events that alters their fate forever.

title: Goli Soda 2
desc: A taxi driver, a gangster and an athlete want to create a space for themselves. However, when fate strikes, they end up losing everything and their struggle towards reclaiming their lives begins.

title: Aasamiyin America Payanam
desc: Accused of murder, a young priest manipulates his associates to flee to America, secretly motivated by the desire to chase after the love of his life.

title: Raatchasi
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

title: Gurkha
desc: A group of ex-army officials takes innocent people at a shopping centre hostage. When a security guard of Gurkha descent learns that the captives include the woman he loves, he sets out to save them.

title: Chevaikalemai
desc: In a village, people are dying of strange circumstances which causes fear and chaos among villagers. A newly appointed police officer investigates and discovers absurd suspects.

title: Magadheera
desc: After waking from a coma with a new face, a man seeks vengeance on the thug who killed his lover. However, as he battles his enemies, he uncovers shocking truths about his identity and past.
